narrative: 摄影机没有“背后”这个概念。场面调度必须在一整个球面空间内成立：剧组人员、灯光和未完工的墙壁都无法躲在操作者的身后。
电影惯常的矩形画幅是后期裁切出来的，或者这件作品本身就是真正的VR。对于经典的覆盖式拍摄手法而言，这不是合适的工具。
如果你需要利用画外空间制造威胁感，就需要一个有边界、经过导演设计的画框。一段只会被当作固定宽景来观看的360度素材，是对整个球面空间的浪费。
how: 使用球面摄影装置，或一对鱼眼镜头拼接成一个等距柱状投影的世界。节点是房间中的一个点，而不是一个矩形画框。
把灯架藏在上方或场景陈设之中；灯光必须真实存在于空间内。提示词：Omnidirectional capture of [Subject], a world that can look every way, spherical space, no off-screen.
when: 当观众必须能够朝任意方向看时使用：VR电影，或一个四面八方都布满陷阱的房间。不要把它当作环绕镜头的一个花哨同义词来用。
vs: 360°环绕（360-Degree Orbit）是一台经过导演调度、沿圆周移动的摄影机；画外空间依然存在。第一人称视角（First-Person）是角色的身体视角，通常是带有双手的矩形画面。
全向拍摄则是一整个球面。摇镜头（Pan）只是在三脚架上做有限角度的转动。
examples_film: VR电影是这种语法的本源形式。《硬核亨利》（Hardcore Henry）是第一人称视角，是主观性上的近亲，但并非球面拍摄。
不要把它引用为360度全景拍摄的例子。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是360°环绕镜头。破绽在于：这是一个有画框的镜头，围绕一个人移动，摄影机身后依然清晰可辨。
解决办法：球面空间，可以朝任意方向观看，没有需要隐藏的剧组人员，也没有画外空间的概念。

faq.q: 电影中的全向拍摄（Omnidirectional）是什么？
faq.a: 全向拍摄用360度摄影机记录一整个球面空间，观众可以朝任意方向观看，操作者身后没有任何东西需要隐藏。

faq.q: 全向拍摄（Omnidirectional）与360°环绕（360-Degree Orbit）的区别
faq.a: 360°环绕是一台带有普通画框的摄影机沿圆周移动。全向拍摄则是没有画外空间概念的球面拍摄。

faq.q: 什么时候该用全向拍摄（Omnidirectional）？
faq.a: 用它拍摄VR内容，或任何必须在各个方向上都成立的场景。当画外空间的威胁感才是重点时，不要用它。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写全向拍摄（Omnidirectional）的提示词？
faq.a: 写明球面空间和可任意方向观看。示例：Omnidirectional capture of [Subject], a world that can look every way, spherical space, no off-screen.

narrative: There is no behind the camera. Staging has to work in a sphere: crew, lights, and unfinished walls cannot hide at the operator's back.
The rectangle of cinema is a later crop, or the piece is truly VR. It is the wrong tool for classical coverage.
If you need off-screen as a threat, you need a directed frame with edges. A 360 file that is only ever viewed as a locked wide is a waste of the sphere.
how: A spherical rig or a pair of fisheyes stitched into an equirectangular world. Nodal point is a point in the room, not a rectangle.
Hide stands above or in set dressing; light has to live in the space. Prompt: Omnidirectional capture of [Subject], a world that can look every way, spherical space, no off-screen.
when: Use it when the audience must be able to look anywhere: VR cinema, a room that is a trap in every direction. Do not use it as a fancy synonym for an orbit.
vs: 360-Degree Orbit is a directed camera walking a circle; there is still off-screen. First-Person is a character's bodily view, usually a rectangle with hands.
Omnidirectional is a sphere. A Pan only yaws a limited angle from sticks.
examples_film: VR cinema is the native grammar. Hardcore Henry is first-person, a cousin in subjectivity, not a sphere.
Do not cite it as 360 capture.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is an orbit-360. The tell: a framed shot that travels around a person with a clear behind-camera.
The fix: spherical space, look-anywhere, no hidden crew, no off-screen.

faq.a: Omnidirectional capture records a sphere with a 360 camera, so the viewer can look any direction and nothing hides behind the operator.
An orbit-360 is a normal framed camera walking a circle. Omnidirectional is spherical capture with no off-screen.
Use it for VR or any scene that must work in every direction. Do not use it when off-screen threat is the point.

faq.q: How do I prompt Omnidirectional for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write spherical space and look-anywhere. Example: Omnidirectional capture of [Subject], a world that can look every way, spherical space, no off-screen.
